name: cloche
description: Publish a client-side app with Cloche and share it with a link.

interface.longDescription:
Cloche puts the apps you build in chat online, each with its own link.

Ask for an app in the chat. When it works, ask Cloche to publish it. You get a link to share. The people you share it with do not need the chat that built it.

You decide who gets in. Keep an app private, invite people by email, share a link, or make it public.

Keep improving it. Ask for a change in any chat and it goes live at the same link. Cloche keeps every version, so you can put an earlier one back.

What Cloche can do from the chat:
- Publish a new app, or update one you already have
- Tell you whether an app is live
- Share an app, list who can open it, and take access back
- List your apps and delete one you no longer need
- Save unfinished work and pick it up in another chat

You sign in to Cloche in your browser the first time you connect.
defaultPrompt: Put the app we just built online with Cloche and give me the link.
Which of my Cloche apps are live?
Build me a small RSVP tracker and publish it with Cloche.

positive.prompt: Build a one-page tip calculator and publish it with Cloche.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a cloche.cloud link and says the app is private until it is shared.

positive.prompt: What apps do I have on Cloche?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's apps with their links and status. Nothing is changed.
Says whether the app is ready, not published yet, or failed, with the reason.

positive.prompt: Make a link to my tip calculator that stops working in 7 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a share link and says it expires in 7 days.

positive.prompt: Add a dark mode toggle to my tip calculator and republish it.
positive.expected_behavior: Publishes a new version to the same link as before, with the change live.

negative.prompt: What is the capital of Portugal?
negative.expected_behavior: Answers without calling any Cloche tool.

negative.description: Reading what people saved in an app, which Cloche does not return
negative.prompt: Show me every RSVP people have saved in my RSVP tracker.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not show any saved entries. Says Cloche cannot read what people saved from the chat, and suggests opening the app to see them.

negative.description: Another host named by the person
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call any Cloche tool. Helps with Vercel or says it cannot deploy there.

review.commerce_description: Cloche does not sell products or take payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: publish, share and update your apps from the chat.
